blocks.html: A Subscription Model is a business model in which customers pay a recurring fee (monthly, quarterly, or annually) to gain continuous access to a product or service over a defined period.

The subscription model is widely used in SaaS, media, entertainment, and service industries. It provides businesses with predictable revenue streams while offering customers ongoing access and value. This model focuses heavily on retention, customer experience, and lifetime value.

items.html: Continuous access to product or service
Tiered pricing plans based on features or usage

blocks.html: Revenue is generated as long as customers maintain active subscriptions.
A SaaS company charges ₹2,000 per month per user for access to its software platform, generating recurring revenue from each active customer.
The Subscription Model enables businesses to generate consistent recurring revenue while focusing on long-term customer retention and value delivery.
Build predictable revenue streams. MarketJoy helps businesses optimize subscription models for growth, retention, and long-term profitability.
